channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Vermont state employees must return to the office at least three days a week starting January tenth. The Vermont Supreme Court ruled in favor of Governor Phil Scott's return-to-office mandate. The governor says the change will improve collaboration and public accessibility.

Whiteface Mountain in Wilmington, New York, opens this morning at nine a.m. with the summit and Little Whiteface slopes ready for skiers. The opening will be phased, with beginner terrain coming later. The mountain installed new snowmaking equipment to prepare for warm weather.

A twenty-two-unit housing development behind Taylor Square in Rutland faces financing risks due to Act two fifty permit delays. Developer Tracy Taylor's loan extension expires at the end of twenty twenty-six. The city aims to gain Tier oneA status to exempt Rutland from Act two fifty regulations.

Rabbit Rabbit Cafe has opened in the Rutland-Southern Vermont Regional Airport terminal. The cafe serves farm-to-table breakfast sandwiches, salads, and local products. Owners Gregory Saint Peter and Kat Hall Saint Peter plan to expand the menu while keeping quality high.
